correctness.rationale: Reconstructed root-to-coefficient equalities f_(n−1)=Tr(alpha), f_1=Tr(alpha^(−1)), f’(1)=Tr((alpha+1)^(−1)). The eight Walsh sums follow from single-character corrections, elliptic K_n recursion and genus-two H_n recursion. The even-index subfield trace vanishes and odd-index preserves the triple, so Möbius inversion counts exact degree n conjugates and divides by n. The finite vectors for degrees 2–9 and Weil bounds plus proper-subfield union bound prove sharp positivity for n≥7. Independently enumerated all monic irreducibles and all eight exact vectors for degrees 2–12 using separately written GF(2) polynomial testing; all agreed. This is finite corroboration; the elliptic/genus-two Weil arguments carry the infinite case.
